mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rate and high inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal a restrictive monetary policy environment that is both tightening and inflationary, which typically leads to negative equity returns as the central bank prioritizes inflation control over growth, resulting in reduced corporate profits and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% AND CPIAUCSL > 200.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by high housing starts (HOUST > 1800) and strong industrial production (INDPRO > 115), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the economy approaches peak growth and the risk of a policy tightening increases.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1800 and INDPRO > 115.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 135,000 (thousands).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1750 thousand units signals weakening demand for housing, which reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1750.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high housing starts (HOUST > 1800) and low industrial production (INDPRO < 110) signal a supply-demand mismatch where strong demand is not met by supply, leading to inflationary pressures and a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1800 and INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 105), where industrial production is weak, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as economic growth slows and corporate margins face pressure, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.
